subject: Backdated usage makeup — invoice and credit plan
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@horizonlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lyte <marcus.lyte@horizonlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected backdated usage on July - can we reconcile?

Hi Ben,

Quick one — we noticed a spike in our July bill that looks like it was applied after our monthly cap kicked in. Attached is our usage export (horizon-usage-Jul2026.csv) showing a cluster of calls from 2026-07-21 to 2026-07-24 that weren't accounted for in the July invoice.

Can you confirm whether these are legitimate calls against our Dedicated pool? If so, please propose how Redwood recommends handling the backdated charge — we'd prefer a single one-time invoice or, if you have crediting options, a partial credit given the timing and our ongoing relationship.

Appreciate a quick turnaround; our finance team needs to close the month.

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Singh
Head of Finance Ops, Horizon Labs
T +1 415-555-0182
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Singh <tara@horizonlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected backdated usage on July - can we reconcile?

Hi Tara — thanks for the note and the export. I dug into the Dedicated logs and can confirm those calls were routed to your reserved pool but were billed as on-demand due to a short-lived autoscale mis-assignment during the 21st–24th window.

Proposed remediation:
- We will issue a one-time invoice for the on-demand delta for those days (itemized).
- Redwood will apply a goodwill credit equal to 35% of the billed delta as a one-off concession for the operational disruption.
- Optionally, we can roll the remaining 65% into a single supplemental invoice or let you pay it on your normal payment term.

I'll attach a short proposal with numbers and an invoice draft once Marissa and finance confirm. If that plan sounds ok to you, flag whether you want the supplemental invoice on standard Net30 or as an immediate charge.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0137
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Singh <tara@horizonlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected backdated usage on July - can we reconcile?

Hi Tara — I pulled the billing delta and attached a short breakdown and proposed invoice (invoice_HWL-3321.pdf) plus our internal remediation summary (redwood-backcharge-proposal.pdf).

Numbers (summary):
- Gross on-demand delta: $12,480.00
- Goodwill credit (35%): -$4,368.00
- Net supplemental charge: $8,112.00

We can issue the net supplemental charge on Net30 or mark it for immediate payment if you'd like it cleared against July close. We will also flag the autoscale routing rule that caused the mis-assignment and have engineering push a guard to prevent recurrence (Vivek is on the thread).

Let me know which payment term you prefer and whether you accept the 35% credit. Once accepted I will finalize the invoice and push the payment link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lyte <marcus.lyte@horizonlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@horizonlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected backdated usage on July - can we reconcile?

Thanks — we reviewed the numbers internally. Tara, we are okay accepting the 35% credit, but because this hits close to month-end I'd like the net invoice to be scheduled Net30. Horizon will not process an immediate charge for this one-off; please proceed with Net30 and provide the invoice with reference to our PO HW-22-19.

If you need exec sign-off for a different cadence, let me know — otherwise approve and send the final invoice.

Marcus
VP, Finance — Horizon Labs

Portal/Payment link: https://pay.redwood.ai/invoice/HWL-3321
